page.title: Do You Need a License for a Yacht Charter in Marbella? 2026 Rules

data.meta_description: Marbella yacht charter license requirements 2026: do you need a boating license for a private charter? All boats include a skipper. No license needed.
data.summary: No license is required for a yacht charter in Marbella because every boat includes a licensed skipper. This 2026 guide explains the rules, what to bring, and how to book with Boat Rental Marbella.
key_facts: No boating license needed for any private charter in Marbella – a licensed skipper is always included.
All boats depart from Puerto Banús, Marbella's main marina.
Skippers are fully insured and hold Spanish navigation qualifications.
You can legally consume alcohol on board – the skipper handles all navigation.
Charters include fuel, insurance, snacks, drinks, and VAT.
Prices start from €749 for 2 hours (Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39).
For larger yachts (Mangusta 80, Ferretti 94), minimum charter is 4 hours from €4,719.

faq.q: Do I need a license to charter a yacht in Marbella?
faq.a: No. All private charters with Boat Rental Marbella include a licensed skipper who holds the required Spanish qualifications. You just relax and enjoy the trip.

faq.q: Can I drive the boat myself if I have a boating license?
faq.a: Our charters are skippered only – you cannot take control of the vessel. This ensures full insurance coverage and safety compliance. If you want a bareboat rental, you would need a separate operator.

faq.q: What license does the skipper have?
faq.a: All our skippers hold a Spanish 'Patrón de Yate' or 'Capitán de Yate' license, which is internationally recognised. They are also fully insured and experienced in navigating the Costa del Sol.

faq.q: Do I need any paperwork to board?
faq.a: Just bring a valid passport or national ID for each passenger. No sailing certificates, medical forms, or special permits are required for a skippered charter.

faq.q: Are there age restrictions for passengers?
faq.a: There is no minimum age for passengers, but children must be supervised at all times. Life jackets are available on board for all sizes. The skipper will brief everyone on safety.

faq.q: What happens if I want to cancel due to bad weather?
faq.a: The skipper makes the final call on weather conditions. If the trip is cancelled for safety reasons, you receive a full refund or can reschedule at no extra cost.

faq.q: Can I bring my own alcohol on board?
faq.a: Yes, you can bring extra drinks, but we already include water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, and cava. The skipper cannot consume alcohol while on duty.

faq.q: How far in advance should I book?
faq.a: For peak summer (June–September), book at least 2–3 weeks ahead. For other months, 1 week is usually fine. Last-minute bookings are possible via WhatsApp (+34 123 456 789).

data.body_html:
Wondering if you need a boating license for a yacht charter in Marbella? The short answer is no – every private charter with Boat Rental Marbella includes a fully licensed skipper. You don't need any qualifications, experience, or paperwork. Just show up at Puerto Banús, step aboard, and let the captain take care of everything. This 2026 guide explains the rules, what's included, and how to book your perfect day on the Costa del Sol.

No License Required – Here's Why

Spanish maritime law requires any vessel over 6 metres in length to be operated by a person holding a valid navigation license. However, when you charter a boat with a skipper, the responsibility – and the license – rests with the professional captain. You are simply a passenger. This applies to every boat in our fleet, from the compact Dubhe (8m, 5 pax) to the superyacht Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax).

All our skippers hold a Spanish Patrón de Yate or Capitán de Yate qualification, which is internationally recognised and covers navigation, safety, and first aid. They are also insured and experienced on the local waters from Marbella to Estepona and Sotogrande.

What's Included in Every Charter

Every booking includes the skipper, fuel, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish VAT (21%). You also get water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, and light snacks. There are no hidden fees. For pricing, see our boat rental Marbella page.

What About Renting a Boat Without a Skipper?

Bareboat charters (without a skipper) are possible in Spain if you hold a valid Patrón de Embarcaciones de Recreo (PER) license or an equivalent international certificate. However, Boat Rental Marbella only offers skippered charters. This means you never need to worry about navigation, docking, or safety checks – just enjoy the Mediterranean.

If you have a license and want to drive, we recommend contacting a bareboat operator separately. For 99% of visitors, the skippered option is far more relaxing.

What to Bring on the Day

  • Valid passport or national ID for each passenger
  • Sunscreen, sunglasses, and a hat (UV is strong even in winter)
  • Swimwear and a towel – we stop for swimming at Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés
  • Light jacket or windbreaker for evenings
  • Extra drinks or snacks if you wish (we already provide basics)

Frequently Asked Questions

Do I need a license to charter a yacht in Marbella?

No. All private charters with Boat Rental Marbella include a licensed skipper who holds the required Spanish qualifications. You just relax and enjoy the trip.

Can I drive the boat myself if I have a boating license?

Our charters are skippered only – you cannot take control of the vessel. This ensures full insurance coverage and safety compliance. If you want a bareboat rental, you would need a separate operator.

What license does the skipper have?

All our skippers hold a Spanish 'Patrón de Yate' or 'Capitán de Yate' license, which is internationally recognised. They are also fully insured and experienced in navigating the Costa del Sol.

Do I need any paperwork to board?

Just bring a valid passport or national ID for each passenger. No sailing certificates, medical forms, or special permits are required for a skippered charter.

Are there age restrictions for passengers?

There is no minimum age for passengers, but children must be supervised at all times. Life jackets are available on board for all sizes. The skipper will brief everyone on safety.

What happens if I want to cancel due to bad weather?

The skipper makes the final call on weather conditions. If the trip is cancelled for safety reasons, you receive a full refund or can reschedule at no extra cost.

Can I bring my own alcohol on board?

Yes, you can bring extra drinks, but we already include water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, and cava. The skipper cannot consume alcohol while on duty.

How far in advance should I book?

For peak summer (June–September), book at least 2–3 weeks ahead. For other months, 1 week is usually fine. Last-minute bookings are possible via WhatsApp (+34 123 456 789).

Still have questions? Contact us or check our full fleet. No license, no stress – just the best day on the water in Marbella.
